name: ai_verifications_one_active_per_artifact
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_verifications_one_active_per_artifact ON public.ai_verifications USING btree (artifact_id) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::ai_verification_status)

name: categories_child_type_parent_id_slug_key
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_child_type_parent_id_slug_key ON public.categories USING btree (type, parent_id, slug) WHERE (parent_id IS NOT NULL)

name: categories_root_type_slug_key
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_root_type_slug_key ON public.categories USING btree (type, slug) WHERE (parent_id IS NULL)

name: contributor_applications_one_pending_per_user
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX contributor_applications_one_pending_per_user ON public.contributor_applications USING btree (user_id) WHERE (status = 'PENDING'::contributor_application_status)

name: storage_policies_one_default
definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX storage_policies_one_default ON public.storage_policies USING btree (is_default) WHERE (is_default = true)
